segmentation.text: It is unlawful for a driver of a vehicle
to fail or refuse to comply with any signal
of an authorized flagger serving in a traffic control capacity
in a clearly marked area of highway construction or maintenance
or any other area which has been designated as a temporary traffic control zone.

elements.justification: 'a vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'driver' is a role read through the vehicle's controlled motion, as the index maps 'The driver of a vehicle' (LVMC_11_20_060_o1).

The flagger's signal is dev.human_direction's 'indication in {stop, proceed, slow, turn(dir)}'. Compliance is read in the subject's motion relative to the flagger's location (dev.position, 'location of the device head', used here as the flagger's place, not as a stop line): the flagger lies ahead of the subject where the vector from kin.position to dev.position has a positive component along kin.heading; passing the flagger is that component turning from positive to not positive. Slowing is read from kin.accel_longitudinal ('acceleration along heading, signed'; not a stand-in for speed); a turn from the heading change integrated from kin.yaw_rate (Term.headingSince).

A flagger is dev.human_direction with role flagger ('a person directing traffic and the direction given'); serving in a traffic control capacity for the subject is the flagger governing (dev.governs) the travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.travel_region). Governance is control, not a position.

dev.temporary_traffic_control: 'cones, barricades, temporary signs and flashers marking works, a closure or an obstruction'. The area of highway construction or maintenance is a travel region lying on a highway (st.on_way, st.highway) that such a device governs (dev.governs) and the subject occupies (rel.occupies).

dev.zone_sign kind temporary_traffic_control, 'a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road', governing (dev.governs) the travel region the subject occupies: the designated temporary traffic control zone is read from its sign; a sign marking the zone's end ('end' attribute) does not designate it.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate vehicle). At the judged observation the subject occupies a travel region r governed (dev.governs) by a dev.human_direction f with role flagger giving an indication, and r is governed by a dev.temporary_traffic_control device and lies on a highway, or is governed by a dev.zone_sign of kind temporary_traffic_control that does not mark the zone's end.
obligation: Re-binding f by the same selection (the flagger governing the region the subject occupies, in such a zone), with 'ahead' meaning the vector from the subject's kin.position to f's dev.position has a positive component along the subject's kin.heading: (stop) it is not the case that f indicates stop at the judged and at the previous observation, f was ahead of the subject at the previous observation and is not ahead at the judged one (the subject passes a flagger showing stop); (slow) it is not the case that f indicates slow and is ahead of the subject while the subject's kin.accel_longitudinal is at or above p.speed_decrease_decel_min (the subject speeds up toward a flagger showing slow); (turn) it is not the case that the subject passes f (ahead at the previous observation, not ahead at the judged one) while f indicates turn(dir) and the subject's heading change since f's turn(dir) indication last rose (Term.headingSince with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph) is not a turn toward dir: for left at least p.turn_heading_min to the left, for right at least p.turn_heading_min to the right, for u_turn of magnitude at least p.u_turn_heading_min. A proceed indication requires no further act.

narrowings.why: 'driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever is at the controls.
'authorized' and 'serving in a traffic control capacity' are the flagger's status and role, read through the flagger's presence directing the region the subject occupies.
'clearly marked' is read through the presence of temporary traffic control devices governing the region; their clarity is not modelled.
'designated' is read through the presence of a temporary traffic control zone sign governing the region.

Compliance is read per indication: stop as not passing the flagger while the stop holds; slow as not speeding up toward the flagger; turn(dir) as having turned toward dir by the time the subject passes the flagger; proceed as a permission whose non-use is not judged.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car occupies a lane governed by a dev.temporary_traffic_control device and by a flagger (dev.human_direction, role flagger) indicating stop; the flagger is ahead of the car, and the car drives past the flagger's position while the indication stays stop.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the car halts short of the flagger and moves past only after the indication has changed to proceed.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No flagger governs the car's lane; cones mark a work area.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the flagger's indication is not observed (dev.human_direction absent).

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The flagger ahead indicates slow; the car's longitudinal acceleration stays above the threshold as it approaches the flagger.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The flagger indicates turn(left); the car drives straight past the flagger's position with almost no heading change since the indication began.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: A person directing traffic with role flagger governs the car's lane but no temporary traffic control device or temporary traffic control zone sign governs it.

param_proposals.name: p.speed_decrease_decel_min
param_proposals.convention: the longitudinal deceleration at or beyond which a sampled acceleration counts as a decrease of speed rather than noise or rolling resistance: the acceleration resolution of the source
param_proposals.source: acceleration resolution of automotive perception and simulator sources

param_proposals.name: p.turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change over the turn window at which a change of course counts as a turn rather than a lane change or a drift
param_proposals.source: intersection turning geometry; lane-change heading changes stay well below it

param_proposals.name: p.u_turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change magnitude over the turn window at which a turn counts as a reversal of direction
